# B00 — Measure before changing

[START](../../guide/00-START.md). Dependencies: none. Outcome: know the real starting point.

Read `package.json`, `.nvmrc`, `.env.example`, `server/config/env.ts`, `server/main.ts`, and the inventory. Do not load secrets. No application edits in this milestone.

## Slices

- **s1:** Inspect revision and uncommitted work. Run existing typecheck, lint, tests and build in a trusted disposable checkout. Capture each command/exit code. Preserve failures rather than silently fixing unrelated files.
- **s2:** Boot over a disposable file database; create a test owner using existing UI/API; send a greeting, create/list a reminder and restart. Record actual effects. Never point destructive tests at owner data.
- **s3:** Record OS, RAM/VRAM, available local runtime, microphone, network, timezone, budget mode and provider access. Unknown values stay unknown. Perform authorized model probes only when credentials and zero-paid limits are established.

Evidence goes to a local ignored `.build/evidence/B00/` directory, or an equivalent external artifact store. Add ignore rules in B01 before committing anything. Do not commit private recordings or credentials.

## Gate

Baseline results must exist even if some fail. B00 is verified when failures and environment are reproducibly characterized; this does NOT certify the app healthy. Product release remains blocked by unresolved failures. Missing hardware/provider access may block later tasks without preventing local baseline work.

Next: B01/s1. Checkpoint names the first concrete unresolved failure and where its evidence lives.
